waiting_on_trader.meaning: Push master: 9 commits ahead of origin (through the batch-1 runtime record).
URGENT check, testnet AND live: is Deribit's 'cancel on disconnect' enabled on the account or the API key? Every app exit and network drop deleted the position's SL and TP on testnet.
URGENT check: in Deribit's testnet order history, the missing SL from a fast-market limit fill. What status and reason does it show (rejected, cancelled, triggered)?

Then launch the testnet experiment seat (Opus, high), after batch 1 is reviewed. It also runs the held slippage-fields check and the chase-anchor reset check. Close your own app first; the seat launches its own testnet instance.

Decide whether to run risk sizing in Live. ⚠ The adversarial audit's partial-fill finding blocks it: risk sizing produces 80-90 USD entries, and a partial fill can flip the account short with no stop. Hold until that is fixed or a 10-USD live cap is in force.
AWS London migration. The key choreography removes the window where two executors run at once.

next_up.what: Fix partial fills: exit legs must track the filled quantity and the take-profit must never open a position (S0 above 10 USD). Blocks risk sizing in Live. Needs experiments (d) and (f) first.

Post-experiment protection batch: emergency reduce-before-cancel, dead stop-leg branch, position-level loss cap, quote-silence watchdog, stop-side check at fill, stand-down cancels the entry, bounded freshness window
Remaining audit rows: trailing trigger offset, close during a socket gap, tick rounding direction, payload reader share mode, small log and feedback items
Remaining hygiene rows need runtime observation or a spec of their own; not clearable by a seat alone
